DragonStrap

A Windows Roblox bootstrapper with installation, updates, profiles, FastFlag management, and recovery tools.

Stable release · v2.7.0
Get the softwareRepositoryGet help

What it does

  • Roblox installation and update controls
  • Disable and restore Player FastFlags, including locked overrides
  • Performance profiles and recovery workspaces

Requirements

Windows 10/11. Choose the Setup or Portable x64 package.

Getting started

Download Setup, Portable, or Fast Folder from the v2.7.0 GitHub release. Extract the whole Fast Folder ZIP into a new folder and run DragonStrap.exe. Compare the file hash with SHA256SUMS.txt supplied with that release.

Stable v2.7.0: Accounts, SYSTEM meters & experimental Mods

The current stable release includes the compact Accounts workspace, system CPU and RAM meters, available temperature readings, and reviewed account workflows. Mods are experimental and require a fresh preview and backup before applying a local asset. Anti-AFK is opt-in and foreground-only; live game acceptance remains unverified. Windows packages are unsigned.

Historical preview: v2.5.0-preview.6

v2.5.0-preview.6 is retained as an earlier Account & Session Center prerelease. It has been superseded by stable releases; v2.7.0 is the default download. Private/specific-server joins, concurrency, restart recovery, and administrator tuning retain documented acceptance limits.

Release notes, integrity & license

Read the current project documentation before installing. Where a release supplies checksums or signed manifests, use the instructions for that exact package. Check the repository’s license and third-party notices before reusing code or assets.

Project information reviewed November 12, 2026. For new versions, follow the repository’s release notes.
